nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=62 beats='Miri unlatches the school coop on the first holiday morning; Clover and Butter hurry out for corn; the smallest hen Pip is not on her perch; Miri counts twice and her tummy flips; three places to look'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=58 beats='inside the coop it smells of warm straw; one brown egg sits in the empty nest of Pip; a floorboard wobbles; tiny three-toed footprints cross the dust toward the back wall'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='bean rows scratched up; a small white feather caught on a sunflower stem; Clover pecks and clucks near the rhubarb patch as if she knows something'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='the gate latch hangs open a crack just wide enough for a small hen; Mr. Okafor waves from next door with his dog Biscuit; a smudge of pale fluff clings to the gatepost'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='a dusty corner behind the nesting boxes; a knothole in the wall boards with pale fluff snagged on it; on tiptoe Miri sees the big hedge pressing against the coop outside'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=58 beats='the footprints march out the pophole and split in two; one line heads straight for the shed door; the other wobbles away toward the old oak on the hill'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=62 beats='little white feathers every few steps like breadcrumbs; the trail forks where the hedge begins; one last feather far off flutters on the creek path below the old oak'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='rhubarb leaves like umbrellas; underneath is a scratched hollow that is still warm; Butter squawks at the fence toward the yard of Mr. Okafor; the shed door stands ajar'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Mr. Okafor listens while Biscuit sniffs the gatepost; he saw a small brown hen scoot past his beans at sunrise; he offers to search his own yard together or points his walking stick up at the old oak'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=58 beats='Miri wriggles through the gap just like a hen would; she lands in the narrow lane between hedge and fence; the hedge rustles on one side; the gate to the neighbor yard waits on the other'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='a green tunnel runs through the hedge, cool and dim; white fluff hangs on the thorns; deeper in there is a dark hollow; off to one side comes a scritch-scratch sound near the compost corner'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=60 beats='the shed smells of earth and string; the seed sack has toppled and spilled a line of seed; the line runs behind the watering cans and dribbles out through a low knothole'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='the yard of Mr. Okafor has tidy bean poles and a big compost bin; Biscuit trots with his nose to the ground; Mr. Okafor points past his fence to where the creek glitters'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='the old oak stands with roots like giant knuckles; a white feather is stuck to the bark; below the slope the creek shines over stepping stones; a faint peep comes from somewhere close'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=60 beats='a little room inside the hedge; feathers and a scooped nest shape in the dry leaves; behind a curtain of brambles comes soft clucking; a narrow tunnel keeps going toward the field'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='behind the sack the seed is everywhere; a watering can lies on its side and rocks a little, with a muffled peep inside; the seed line also dribbles out the knothole toward the field'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='by the compost bin the scratching is loud; the lid sits crooked as if something pushed it; a watering can by the tap wobbles all by itself; Miri holds her breath and listens'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=62 beats='between two big roots is a hollow lined with leaves; white feathers and one warm spot in the middle; from the creek below, a peep echoes off the stones'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=60 beats='pebbles crunch on the creek bank; the stepping stones shine with wet moss; on the flat middle stone a small brown shape preens its feathers; up the slope the oak roots make dark hollows'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=58 beats='the can rocks and out blinks Pip, dusty all over with seed stuck to her beak; she is wedged in snug and looks quite cross about it'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=62 beats='behind the brambles sits Pip, fluffed up in the scooped nest and refusing to move; she is sitting on something small and round; her feathers puff bigger when Miri reaches near'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=60 beats='at the field edge the trail stops at an old rabbit burrow; seed husks are scattered at its dark mouth; a soft rustle comes from inside, too deep to see'>>

choices.label: Head back and mend the gap

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=62 beats='the lid comes up on warm dark compost, wriggly worms, and Pip in the middle of a worm feast with dusty wings; she squawks, very surprised to be found'>>

choices.label: Call for help walking her home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=60 beats='in the leaf-lined hollow between the roots Pip nestles low on a hidden nest; the tip of a smooth warm egg peeks out beneath her; the creek chatters just below the slope'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=58 beats='Pip preens on the flat middle stone while water burbles around her; the stones are slick with wet moss; from the path Mr. Okafor calls hello, with Biscuit at his heel'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Miri carries Pip home warm against her jumper; Clover and Butter fuss a loud welcome at the coop door; Pip settles onto her own perch; Miri latches everything twice and grins; three hens, counted and safe'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='under Pip sits one small perfect egg; the little hen had made herself a secret nest; Miri carries hen and egg home and builds Pip a snug nesting box of her very own; Pip settles in like a queen; mystery solved'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Mr. Okafor walks on one side, Biscuit trots slow and proud on the other, and Miri herds Pip up the lane; Clover and Butter join the line at the gate; the whole parade marches to the coop; corn for everyone'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Miri wedges a board across the gate gap and hammers it snug; while she works, Pip strolls back all by herself, dusty and pleased; Miri never finds out where she went, but the gap is mended and tomorrow she will watch closer'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Pip leads Miri on a zigzag march past the beans, around the shed, and through the gate; at last Pip trots into the coop all by herself; hen and girl are both tired and hungry; Miri writes the whole adventure in the hen notebook'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Miri slips on the wet bank with a splash; Pip flutters safely up the slope; Mr. Okafor helps Miri out and walks her home; Pip is already back in the coop looking smug; Miri cleans her muddy boots and learns to move slowly around hens'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='the seed trail works; Pip pokes out of the burrow, pecking her way seed by seed right up to Miri; scooped up warm and safe; home before lunch with the best story ever, the hen who tried the rabbit door'>>
